items.title: Bill Goodwin interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 28, 2025
items.q: I said Elvis is very good. I really liked him... But I didn’t — I never really bought Elvis’s records.

ctx.x: I see. What about the early rock & roll?

Well rock & roll was happening, started happening when I already loved west coast jazz. And you know Elvis’s first records came out. But I used to listen to a lot of rhythm & blues you know, Fats Domino and Chuck Berry, Bo Diddley, and the blues, the Howlin’ Wolf and Muddy Waters and all those guys. And they put out singles but they were considered race records. It hadn’t crossed over at that point, until later. And I loved that stuff, and I thought Elvis was — I said Elvis is very good. I really liked him, but…
